title: On-Time Rooming List Allotment for Group Room Blocks
content:
**Rider.** At the cut-off release of a Group Room Blocks rooming-list block an on-time list allotment is kept back from the release. It follows when the rooming list arrived, read as the latest booking date of the organiser's confirmed Group Block Rate reservations naming the block, against the block type's rooming-list due period:

- that date at least the due period **plus 7** calendar days before arrival: an allotment of **6** room nights;
- at least the due period but fewer than that: **3** room nights;
- later: none.

**Records read.** The booking dates of the organiser's Room Reservations that name the block, are booked at the Group Block Rate and stand confirmed; the latest of those dates is the date the list arrived.

### Bands for the rooming-list block types

| Block type | Rooming-list due period (days before arrival) | 6 room nights when the list arrived | 3 room nights when it arrived | None when it arrived |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sports Team Room Block | 14 | 21 days or more before arrival | 14 to 20 days before arrival | fewer than 14 days before arrival |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 30 | 37 days or more before arrival | 30 to 36 days before arrival | fewer than 30 days before arrival |

### Example (hypothetical Sports Team Room Block)

The list's reservations were booked on several dates, the latest 18 days before arrival: the allotment is 3 room nights. Had the last of them been booked 21 days before arrival, it would be 6.
